subject: Encryption controls: operator statement + control matrix request
messages:
From: Alyssa Romero <alyssa.romero@skylineinc.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@skylineinc.com
Date: Thu, 19 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG/CAIQ follow-up — KMS/HSM operator evidence needed

Hi Olga / Marissa,

Thanks for the quick intro on the call yesterday. Per our SIG intake and the CAIQ appendix, our auditors have asked for the following from Redwood so we can close the encryption section:

- A short signed operator statement describing HSM operator roles and onsite/remote access controls (one page preferred)
- A control matrix mapping CAIQ items to Redwood artifacts (pointer to SOC2 section, KMS design doc, attestation)
- Sample rotation logs for the last 90 days (redacted but with timestamps, operator IDs, and rotation event types)
- HSM attestation summary / vendor FIPS/PKCS#11 certs if available

Can you confirm what you can provide and an estimated delivery date? For the rotation logs we can accept CSV extracts with hostnames redacted; we only need to see evidence of timely rotation and operator approvals.

Attachments: I attached our intake checklist (Skyline_SIG_questions_v2.docx) — that has the specific CAIQ IDs auditors flagged.

If it helps, we can set up a short 30-min review after you share a draft.

Best,
Alyssa
Alyssa Romero
Senior GRC Analyst, Skyline Financial
alyssa.romero@skylineinc.com
+1 415 555 0123

Attachment stub: Skyline_SIG_questions_v2.docx (application/msword, 96KB)

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Romero <alyssa.romero@skylineinc.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Jul 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ follow-up — KMS/HSM operator evidence needed

Hi Alyssa — thanks for the list and the checklist. Appreciate the clear asks.

Quick summary of what we can provide and proposed timeline:

1) Operator statement: we can produce a concise signed statement (PDF) outlining operator roles, separation-of-duty, MFA for operator consoles, and emergency dual-approval flows — target 48 hours. (Attachment: operator-statement-sample.pdf)

2) Control matrix: we have a CAIQ->artifact mapping we maintain internally. I will extract a customer-friendly matrix that points to our SOC2 report sections and the KMS architecture doc — target 3 business days.

3) Rotation logs: we can provide redacted CSV extracts showing rotation events, actor id (internal operator id), event type (rekey/rotate/rotate-kek), and timestamp. We will scrub hostnames and tenant ids. Sample file included for format: rotation-log-sample-202806.csv. For full dataset our security team needs to review for PD/PI redaction — please confirm the exact time window you need (90 days OK?).

4) HSM attestation & vendor certs: we have the HSM vendor attestation summary and FIPS validation references. Can include in the package.

A couple of notes / clarifying questions:
- For legal/contract reasons we do not export private key material; the logs and attestations demonstrate control without sharing sensitive key material.
- If the auditors need machine-level logs (syslog), we'll need a data transfer agreement and an agreed redaction template.

I'll prepare the initial package and drop it to a secure share (we prefer a short-lived signed link or your SFTP). Ben, can you help coordinate the transfer and NDA/DocuSign if they need one?

Olga
Olga Petrov
Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Attachment stubs: operator-statement-sample.pdf (application/pdf, 28KB); rotation-log-sample-202806.csv (text/csv, 12KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>

On Thu, Jul 19, 2028 at 11:03 AM Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai> wrote:
> I'll prepare the initial package and drop it to a secure share (we prefer a short-lived signed link or your SFTP). Ben, can you help coordinate the transfer and NDA/DocuSign if they need one?

Hi Alyssa — thanks for the checklist and for clearly outlining the deliverables. Happy to coordinate.

Plan:
- We'll create a secure share (short-lived Google Drive link with view/download audit) and post the initial package there by Friday EOD PT.
- If Skyline requires a data transfer agreement / BAA or DocuSign for log exports, I'll have a standard two-party DTA/Amendment ready and can route it through DocuSign (I copied our legal template).
- Suggestion: call to review the operator statement and sample rotation CSV on Monday morning (30 min) to confirm auditors' redaction needs before we export a larger set.

Can you confirm a preferred time slot Mon 10–11am PT or Tue 2–3pm PT?

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
+1 650 555 6789

From: Alyssa Romero <alyssa.romero@skylineinc.com>

Cc: security@skylineinc.com
Date: Sat, 21 Jul 2028 16:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ follow-up — KMS/HSM operator evidence needed

Thanks all — that timeline works. Confirming a few specifics from the auditors: they want a 90-day window for rotation events (May 20–Aug 18, 2028), with operator IDs pseudonymized but consistent (we need to see the same operator ID across events so we can verify separation-of-duty). Hostnames and tenant ids must be redacted.

On the DTA: we do not require a BAA for this dataset; DocuSign for a short DTA is fine and I can circulate the signed copy quickly. Please include the HSM attestation summary and indicate the vendor validation numbers (FIPS cert refs).

Proposed call: Monday 30 Jul 2028, 10:30am PT — will that work for you? If so, I'll send a calendar invite.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Alyssa
